ticker_holdout.access: only first/last date and length of the price data were checked; no returns or signals were computed (the 2026-10-23 BUY scan used only the 337 development tickers)

cells.forward_test: every signal from 2026-10-24 on (paper trading); the only period nobody has seen

development.universe: 337 tickers = the 253 earlier development tickers + the 84 spent v4-holdout tickers
development.rule: every series cut before 2024-10-22; the v5 holdout tickers refused by the data loader

caveats: no unseen RECENT period exists any more: 2024-10-22 .. now was the v4 time holdout (for other tickers) and the market path (SPY) of that period is known; the TICKER holdout is clean, the time component only partly, and only the forward test is fully clean
the market regime rule (spy_roc63 <= 3%) was chosen with data up to 2024-10; its holdout result is known for 2024-10 .. now
